boughtOutComponents.description: 4-Wire Spiral High Pressure Arm Hydraulic Hoses

workflowSteps.title: Drawing Release
workflowSteps.incomingData: Engineering CAD Model, Drawing Rev A (JCB-ARM-BOOM-001)
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Locked Released Drawing distributed to Stores and Floor

workflowSteps.title: BOM & Material Issue
workflowSteps.incomingData: Released BOM-BCM-SF-001, 15,800 kg IS 2062 E350 Structural Plate
actions: Issue material with Heat No. HT-2026-9921
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Material Issue Slip #MIS-2026-0041, Raw plates transferred to Cutting bay

workflowSteps.title: CNC Cutting & Profiling
workflowSteps.incomingData: Heat-stamped steel plates, CNC nesting program
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Beveled cut plates, Scrap reconciliation entry, WIP travel card

workflowSteps.title: Fit-Up & Tack Assembly
workflowSteps.incomingData: Cut plates, internal diaphragms, welding platen fixture
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Tacked boom box structure ready for full penetration welding

workflowSteps.title: Welding Bay
actions: Execute rework repairs if routed back from QC
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Fully welded boom structure with welder ID stamp

workflowSteps.title: In-Process QC Inspection
workflowSteps.incomingData: Welded structure, NDT procedure, inspection checklist
actions: Pass inspection OR Fail with defect photo and route to rework
workflowSteps.outgoingData: QC Clearance Green Tag OR Rework Ticket routed back to Welding Bay

workflowSteps.title: Machining & Line Boring
workflowSteps.incomingData: QC-cleared boom, CNC horizontal boring mill
actions: Line bore pivot pin holes to H7 tolerance

workflowSteps.title: Surface Prep & Painting
workflowSteps.incomingData: Machined boom structure, JCB Yellow polyurethane paint
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Finished painted boom, DFT report signed off

workflowSteps.title: Sub-Assembly Sign-off
workflowSteps.incomingData: Finished Boom, Dipper, and Bucket sub-assemblies
actions: Clear sub-assembly for Main Assembly integration
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Approved sub-assembly components available for Arm Assembly

workflowSteps.title: Main Assembly Integration
workflowSteps.incomingData: Boom + Dipper + Bucket + 4 Bought-Out Component Sets (Cylinders, Pins, Bolts, Hoses)
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Integrated ARM-ASM module ready for Excavator mounting

workflowSteps.title: Master JCB-001 Rollup
workflowSteps.incomingData: Completed Main Assemblies (Arm, Carriage, Undercarriage, Cabin)
workflowSteps.outgoingData: Completed client delivery, Full immutable traceability audit history
